system.description:
Make an Interface Roll (13). Ona
success, you force a fragment of the
Blackwall to manifest between two
points within Far range as a corrupted
digital wall spilling into physical space.
It does not appear as a solid wall, but
as a violent fracture of static, hostile
code, and AI corruption expressed
through the surrounding environment.
This lasts until you mark your next HP.
Any creature inside the wall when it
appears, or that passes through it,
marks 2 Stress, then must succeed a
Reaction Roll (26) or are Restrained.
